description: Runs a factory on this machine with the model key set in this server's environment (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY), or a local OpenAI-compatible server (provider "ollama" or base_url, with model). It can take minutes. It returns when the run is done, fails, or reaches a human decision: then it returns run_id, the text to show, seen_sha256 and approval_id. Show the person the text, get their decision, and call resume_run. Never decide for them.
name: run_factory
title: Run a factory
